title: Capital Structure Effects Associated with the New Lease Accounting Standard
eligible_reason: Near-miss, not eligible as reported. The design is treat x post for ASC 842 adoption, where post switches on in the first fiscal quarter of the fiscal year beginning after 15 Dec 2018 and therefore varies across firms only through fiscal-year-end month (12 possible adoption quarters 2019Q1-2020Q1, with 4,014 of 4,951 firms on December year-ends). Every regression includes post as a separate time-varying regressor alongside treat_post with firm and calendar-quarter FE (reghdfe long_debt_excl treat_post post, absorb(firm year_month) vce(cluster firm)); post is not collinear with the quarter FE because of non-December year-ends, so it is an additional time-varying control, which the protocol excludes. Other columns add lev size roa, entropy-balancing weights ([aweight=_webal]), treatment-intensity deciles and cross-sectional interactions. The panel is short (2018Q1-2019Q4) and essentially a single policy date.
design_notes: Firm-quarter Compustat panel; C_FLR main do file.do keeps datadate >= 31mar2016 and < 1mar2020 for construction, then keep if datadate >= 31mar2018 for estimation (lines 29-30, 208); drops firms with < 8 quarters, early adopters (3_d_early_adopters.dta; also firms with operating lease liabilities or right-of-use assets before post) and firms whose long_debt_excl <= 0. post (lines 33-44) = 1 from 31mar2019 for fyr==12, 30apr2019 for fyr==1, ..., 28feb2020 for fyr==11. treat (lines 131-134) = 1 if the firm reports nonzero operating lease liabilities (given_oll) in any post quarter. time FE year_month is recoded to calendar quarter (year*100 + quarter, lines 55-62). Outcome long_debt_excl = ln(dlttq + dd1q - given_oll). Table 2: col 1 treat_post post; col 2 + lev size roa; col 3 + entropy-balance weights (ebalance treat lev size roa); cols 4-5 add treat_int_post (decile of lease intensity); high/low intensity subsamples. Table 3: interactions with FloatingGAAP measures; Table 4: pviol and effect-group interactions; Table 5: relative industry intensity. Graphs do-file: relative-time event-study with treat x before/after bins plus controls and firm FE only (lines 105-128).
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Adoption quarter is determined by fiscal-year-end month: fyr 12 -> 2019Q1 (4,014 firms in the 2018Q1-2020Q1 window), fyr 1-11 -> 2019Q2 through 2020Q1 (937 firms spread over 11 months). A single standard with mechanically staggered effective dates; the shipped B_FLR_Sep_2021.dta has 5,765 gvkeys before sample cuts.

specs.exclusion_reason: additional time-varying regressor post in the regression (not absorbed by calendar-quarter FE because adoption dates vary by fiscal year-end); near-miss: dropping post or replacing it with fiscal-year-end-group x quarter FE would yield an eligible static TWFE
specs.outcome: long_debt_excl (ln of long-term debt plus current portion minus recognized operating lease liabilities)
specs.treatment_var: treat_post (= treat x post); components treat, post
specs.treatment_definition: treat = firm reports operating lease liabilities after ASC 842 adoption; post = fiscal quarters from the firm's ASC 842 adoption quarter (fiscal years beginning after 15 Dec 2018; adoption quarter depends on fyr)
specs.sample_condition: datadate >= 31mar2018 & < 1mar2020; >= 8 quarters per firm; early adopters dropped; long_debt_excl > 0; atq non-missing
specs.notes: Flag for lead: if the post main effect is treated as a function of a time-invariant characteristic (fiscal year-end) interacted with time, this column could be reconsidered; as coded it is an extra additive regressor.

specs.exclusion_reason: treatment-intensity regressors (treat_int_post decile) and interactions with firm characteristics; controls; entropy-balance weights
specs.treatment_definition: as above plus decile-rank intensity interactions

specs.exclusion_reason: relative-time bins with treat main effect, controls lev size roa, and firm FE without calendar-time FE (lines 125-128); the version at line 105 has quarter FE but includes controls
specs.treatment_var: treat_before3plus treat_before2 treat_before1 zerox treat_after1 treat_after2 treat_after3plus

data_files_note: README says data are not included due to licensing, but the Compustat-derived .dta files the main do-file merges are present (names differ slightly from the do-file: FLR_Sep_2021.dta -> B_FLR_Sep_2021.dta, reduction.dta -> 1_d_reduction.dta, etc.). Some variable names in B_FLR_Sep_2021.dta are upper case (DLTTQ, DD1Q) while the do-file uses lower case; check before running.
software_notes: Stata 17+ (reghdfe, ebalance, xtile); SAS on WRDS for data acquisition.
priority_note: Not eligible as reported (post main effect in every column; near single-date design). Recorded as a near-miss for the lead's decision.
screener_notes: Screened from package only. Fiscal-year-end cohort counts computed from B_FLR_Sep_2021.dta over 2018Q1-2020Q1 before the do-file's sample cuts. Table numbering from do-file comments (Table 2: Main effect; Table 3: Fixed versus floating GAAP; Table 4: Probability of violating debt contracts; Table 5: Leary and Roberts).
